name: cn.tuanjie.openharmony.hilog

author.name: You San Di Technology (Shanghai) Co., LTd.

_upm.changelog: 首次发布 OpenHarmony Hilog Package / initial release of OpenHarmony Hilog Package

description:
The OpenHarmony Hilog package has been enhanced to support displaying log messages from OpenHarmony devices in Tuanjie Editor, as well as performing stack trace restoration, memory capture, and ArkUI Dump retrieval. 

 You can access this window in Tuanjie Editor by navigating to “Window > Analysis > OpenHarmony Hilog.” 

 If this menu does not appear, please ensure that the OpenHarmony platform is loaded. 

 OpenHarmony Hilog 包增加了对于在 Tuanjie Editor 中显示来自 OpenHarmony 设备的日志消息并进行还原堆栈、抓取内存、拉取ArkUI Dump的支持。 

 可以在 Tuanjie Editor 中通过 “Window > Analysis > OpenHarmony Hilog” 来访问该窗口。 

 如果这个菜单不存在，请确保已加载 OpenHarmony 平台。
